title: MOSS-Image Base (int8)
about: MOSS-Image Base, int8. Flexible but not preference-tuned: it wants long, concrete prompts, so the prompt expander is on (the 9B text encoder rewrites your idea into a full caption first). No turbo merged in: the Turbo chip adds a turbo LoRA (Kromoss DMD2 8-step suits Base) or switch to the SFT DeBand card for DeBand Fast. ER-SDE 25 steps, cfg 3 to start; the community runs Base at 50 or more steps. Base has no banding.

title: MOSS-Image SFT DeBand (int8)
about: MOSS-Image SFT with the banding fix merged in (DeBand), int8, with Dylan's graph: Temporal Score Rescaling 0.95 / 1.0 and skip-layer guidance on single blocks 22, 24 from 10 to 70 %, ER-SDE 25 steps, cfg 3. SFT always carries a deband fix. Turbo: the DeBand Fast merge (DMD at 0.35, 10 steps) swaps the checkpoint, or add an SFT DMD / DMAD LoRA row.

title: Kromoss (int8)
about: Kromoss: lodestones' full fine-tune of MOSS-Image Base at 1024 px, int8; keep it at or under about 2.5 MP. Skip-layer guidance on layer 22 as its card says; ER-SDE 25 steps, cfg 3 here (the Kromoss card itself uses Euler, 50 steps, shift 5). Turbo: the Kromoss DMD2 8-step LoRA (Euler, 8 steps, cfg 1, no negative), which the community rates best on Kromoss; use one DMD LoRA at a time.

title: Krea 2 Raw (fp8)
about: Krea 2 Raw loaded as fp8_e4m3fn (the int8 ConvRot file is int8_rowwise, which core ComfyUI can't load), the stock Qwen3-VL 4B encoder and the Qwen-Image VAE, res_multistep with the beta schedule (0.6, 0.6), 30 steps, cfg 4: the settings the Krea dials were calibrated on. Turbo: the Krea 2 Turbo fp8 merge swaps the checkpoint (8 steps, cfg 1, ddim; its workflow's beta57 isn't in core, so beta). The Krea dials only steer toward their A side.
